UPSO.source: SOG UPSO-labelled validation notebook and legacy unified-swarm controls

GIVP.source: SOG GIVP Optuna best configuration (two-worker variant)

notes: The seven inflow scenarios are frozen by benchmark v1.0.0 and are identical across the five paired stochastic seeds.
PSO is executed by pyswarm, preserving the engine and the population, inertia and acceleration controls of the SOG notebook.

DE uses one execution worker although the original SOG notebook requested all workers. This isolates the deterministic local physical evaluator from platform-dependent multiprocessing; all evolutionary controls are preserved.

UPSO is a true unified swarm with ring-local and global social targets. The SOG notebook labelled UPSO invoked the PSO wrapper, so the distinction is recorded rather than represented as an exact historical replay.
All algorithms share a maximum budget of 15000 physical objective evaluations; elapsed time is reported separately.
